remarks: Welcome to this stunning garden style apartment located in the heart of downtown Stamford, CT! This beautiful 2nd-floor unit offers a private entrance and an abundance of natural light that accentuates the lovely hardwood floors throughout. Included in the HOA is heat and hot water, making it easy to stay warm and cozy during the colder months. You'll also have the convenience of a reserved parking spot right outside your door, ensuring that you never have to worry about finding parking in the city. This prime location puts you just steps away from the Ridgeway Shopping Center, where you'll find a variety of shopping and dining options. Enjoy a delicious meal at one of the many nearby restaurants or take a stroll through the beautiful Scalzi Park. You'll also have easy access to public transportation and LA Fitness making it easy to stay active and explore all that the city has to offer. With the Metro just minutes away, commuting to and from work is a breeze. Don't miss your chance to make this beautiful apartment your home in downtown Stamford!
